summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting across login  ### What I found (read-only audit, no edits made)  I traced the full chain: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` / SQLite.  **Good news — most of the chain is correctly scoped:** - Sessions are DB-backed (`sessions` table keyed by `user_id`), not in-memory, so they survive server restarts and work across devices. - `arca_session` cookie is set with `httpOnly`, `sameSite: Lax`, `path: /`, `maxAge: 30 days` — persists correctly. - Every watchlist read/write (`
